PASS WITH NOTES — performance/266 round 2 (final), exact head dabbd04062d73a12ffef2a831bd7e2f2030c8f8a.

P266-001 CLOSED. Reviewed the exact delta from 890515121f3d8f38cc96947847e7178ce42e1cc9 and confirmed detached HEAD. http/mod.rs:611-615,642 builds RouteCounts once from Endpoint::ALL. route_counts.rs:118-129 sorts/deduplicates the static templates into a boxed slice with inline counters. record (:134-158) performs a binary search using the same string ordering, borrows the inline PathCounts, chooses the bounded method slot and increments the appropriate relaxed atomic. No mutex, per-route Arc clone or first-request allocation remains in record. Missing or unknown templates increment the fixed unmatched bucket.

snapshot (:163-195) only reads atomics and builds the owned output projection; no accounting lock is held, and names are formatted only after a nonzero outcome was read. Requests cannot be serialized behind snapshot formatting through the old global mutex. Endpoint storage and the 128 seat-shape slots remain bounded. API docs accurately distinguish the extra seats-query scan/increment, non-transactional per-atomic reading and wrapping total/counters.
